text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school building, 
I heard the cheerful voices of students.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, that pose you did in the paddock 
the other day was so badass! Looked just 
like a special move!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I saw it too! You looked so dignified and 
wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of you two! What a 
wonderful eye for detail you have.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is called the "Pose of the Noble 
One," a pose symbolizing true nobility!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Pose of the Noble One"...!? Whoaaa, even 
the name sounds badass!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Do you have other poses too? Man, I wanna 
see 'em!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course! A true princess lives up 
to everyone's expectations, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, would you prefer the "Pose of 
the Brawny One" or the "Pose of the True 
Princess"?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, obviously—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
The "Pose of the Brawny One"! The "Pose of 
the True Princess"!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet, don't get in my way! I wanna 
learn about strength from Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah? That's my line! I want to learn the 
spirit of a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmm, now this is quite a predicament...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer, perfect timing! Would you be 
so kind as to decide for us?
choice_data_list: Let's see the "Pose of the True Princess"
How about the "Pose of the Brawny One"?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then here comes the "Pose of 
the True Princess"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oho~hohoho!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is the pose Shiny Princess strikes 
whenever she triumphs over adversity!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shiny Princess is the main character from 
"Purifight," right? I used to watch that 
all the time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. A princess never forgets her 
elegance no matter the situation, and that 
is a mindset I always strive to emulate♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Elegance in any situation... How 
wonderful. I'd love to learn from that—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!! No way, there's a bug at my 
feet...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, what an ill-mannered pest, 
interrupting a lovely maiden chat.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For an insolent intruder like you—TAAAKE 
THIIIS!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess threw a ferocious punch 
aimed straight at the bug on the floor!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOOOOOM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There we go... The little pest has been 
dealt with.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us resume our discussion to 
our hearts' content♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected... I don't think I can ever 
match you when it comes to stuff like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then here comes the "Pose of 
the Brawny One"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: EIYAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is the pose Shiny Princess strikes 
after defeating a formidable foe!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shiny Princess is the protagonist from 
"Purifight," right? I used to watch that 
all the time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. A princess boldly confronts any 
adversary, and that resolve is something I 
always strive to emulate♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, what a powerful punch! So badass! 
Can I see it one more time?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, of course♪ Here I go—SEEEEI!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Another fierce punch was unleashed—or so 
it seemed, but it felt much weaker than 
the first one.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Hey! That was no good, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You let your guard down because you were 
flattered. That punch lacked real 
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gasp...!? For me to display such an 
unrefined act in front of everyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess must always carry herself with 
utmost nobility! H-How 
embarrassingggggg~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter-clatter-clatter-thud—!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...? What was she so embarrassed about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-Who knows...?
